open_points.subject: Project anonymisation after restore
open_points.text: “every other mark carries the instant of its repetition” contradicts M01: an anonymised Project keeps its mark but “every instant” is gone and the audit entry alone holds when it was anonymised
open_points.question: After repeating an anonymisation following restore, does the Project retain the repetition instant with its anonymised mark, or does only the new audit entry retain that instant?
options: The Project retains the anonymised mark and repetition instant
The Project retains only the anonymised mark; the audit entry retains the repetition instant
open_points.default_guess: The Project retains only the anonymised mark, preserving R0-62, R0-87 and M01.

open_points.subject: Recovery of lifecycle prerequisites
open_points.text: “The owner brings each record to the state its latest recorded action leaves” does not say how an erasure is repeated when the restored backup holds the project as active but the recorded post-backup state requires anonymising or deleting an archived project
open_points.question: Which product action or recorded fact restores the required archived state before the owner repeats an archived-project erasure?
options: The retention record also records and replays the intervening archive action
The owner archives the restored project anew from other knowledge before repeating the erasure
The erasure action may bypass its archived-project precondition during disaster recovery
open_points.default_guess: The owner archives the project anew with the ordinary archive action before repeating the recorded erasure.
